Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the action! The players stride out to the middle. Sophie Devine and Suzie Bates will the open the innings for New Zealand Women. Jhulan Goswami has the ball in hand. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! 280 is what New Zealand Women have to chase to seal the series. India Women would feel they have got runs on the board and would fancy defending it and thus, stay alive in the series. Stay tuned to see how the chase unfolds.

Frances Mackay is up for a chat. She says it was great to get out there and to contribute to the team. Adds she is bowling in the nets for quite some while now as she has not played ODI since November. Tells they bowled very well, apart from at the top where India played aggressively. Informs that the boundaries are a little bit shorter.

New Zealand Women bowlers had a poor start as they had no answers to the onslaught from the Indian openers and remained clueless. Rosemary Mair then got the much-needed breakthrough as she got rid of Meghana. That opening was all New Zealand needed as they pulled things exceedingly well after that and contained the pressure. The players were excellent in the field taking some outstanding catches especially Frances Mackay who got a wicket and was also effective in two run-outs of her own bowling. New Zealand Women chased down 271 in the second ODI and would again bank on their batters to chase this down.

India were off to a flying start as Sabbhineni Meghana was in a menacing mood and was dealing only in boundaries while Shafali Verma was supporting her very well. The duo stitched up a 100-run partnership but both got out soon after scoring their respective fifties. After that, India went from 100-0 to 187-5. The openers laid the platform for a big score but the middle order failed to get going. However, Deepti Sharma played a handy knock and stayed till the end stranded at 69*. India Women have put up a good total but they would be disappointed that they didn't cross the 300 figure as the openers had laid the foundation for that.

The openers provided a blazing start and India lost its steam in the middle but Deepti Sharma played an excellent knock which took them to 279 which is also their highest total against New Zealand Women in ODIs. The White Ferns will still be pretty pleased with their efforts here and would look to seal the series with a win.

OUT! TAKEN! Renuka Singh tries to give a big finish but holes one out. Flatter and outside off. Singh swings across but without much timing. Hits it towards mid off where Suzie Bates runs to her right and takes an easy catch. India Women are bundled out on 279.
Commentary.Howout: c Suzie Bates b Frances Mackay

Very full and on middle, pushed to the left of mid off. Verma wanted a single but she was sent back.
Fuller and on off. Meghana drops it to covers for a single.
Shafali Verma is getting some attention from the physio. She is down on the pitch. Not sure what is the reason. She is fine now and we are ready to resume.

Dropped! A sitter by Hannah Rowe! This is full and on middle. Meghana steps forward and looks to heave but gets a top edge towards mid on. Hannah Rowe there tracks back and got to a good position but fails to catch it. A chance goes begging. Single taken.
On a length, on off, punched to point.
Short again and this time it is pulled through square leg for a couple of runs.
Wide! Short, slower and down the leg side. Meghana misses her pull.
SIX! BANG! A full ball, in the slot, on middle. Meghana clears her front leg and heaves it all the way over wide long on for a biggie.
Bangs a short one now, outside off. Left alone.
Short of a length, angling on middle. Meghana dabs it to point.
Sophie Devine comes into the attack. She replaces Hannah Rowe.
Short in length, around off. Shafali sways away from it, drops her bat and lets it through.

FOUR! A length ball, outside off. Verma punches off the back foot through point. The ball slows down a bit but touches the rope just before the fielder from across cuts it off. A run out appeal but of no use. 50 up for India. Bright start for them.
Length ball, outside off, this is hit to point.
Short ball, outside off. Meghana slaps it to third man for a single. New Zealand have made sure boundaries don't come much now. Good comeback.
Length and on off. Blocked out.
Good stop! A length ball, outside off. Verma cuts it to the left of point and the fielder there gets a hand to it. Saves a boundary there. Just a single taken.
Short and outside off, width there to be hit but Meghana is not tempted.
SAFE AGAIN! Short of a length, on middle. Meghana is a touch early as she pulls it over mid on for a couple of runs.
A short ball, on middle, steep bounce there. Meghana misses her pull.
In the air but safe! Fuller and outside off. Verma looks to go big but the outward movement takes the splice of the blade and goes over backward point for a single.
Around off, full and pushed to point. Lauren Down there makes a good stop.
FOUR! In the gap! A length ball, outside off, shaping away. Verma punches it through point for a boundary. What a start this is for India.
And again! Short of a length, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana lets it sail through.
Another one! Short of a length, on middle. Sabbhineni Meghana leaves it for the keeper to collect.
Short of a length, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana lets it go.
Short of a length, outside off. Shafali Verma dabs it to third man for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Shafali Verma has a slash at it but misses.
On a length, on off. Shafali Verma defends it out.
Slower ball, on off. Sabbhineni Meghana knocks it back to the bowler. 16 runs from the over.
Fantastic answer from Hannah Rowe! Bangs a short ball, on middle. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to pull but misses. Optimistic appeal for a caught behind but nothing from the umpire.
SIX! BANG! This is impressive! Length ball, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana stands tall and hammers it all the way over long off for a maximum. What does Hannah Rowe do now?
On a length, on off. Sabbhineni Meghana tries to defend. But the ball takes the outside edge and goes to third man for a couple.
FOUR! Three consecutive boundaries! Slightly fuller, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana looks to drive. The ball goes off the outside edge to deep backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! Both the openers are dealing in boundaries at the moment. Length ball, on off. Sabbhineni Meghana slaps it over covers for a cracking boundary.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Length ball, on off. Shafali Verma presses forward and slams it over mid off. One bounce and into the fence.
Bangs a short ball now, on off. Shafali Verma ducks under it.
On a good length, outside off, nipping away. Shafali Verma look to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Much better from Lea Tahuhu! Good-length ball, outside off, nipping away. Shafali Verma looks to push but misses.
FOUR! This is an excellent start from India Women! Short and wide, outside off. Shafali Verma stays deep and punches it through point. The ball races away to the boundary.
Good-length ball, on off, nipping away. Shafali Verma defends it towards covers.
Touch fuller, outside off, Sabbhineni Meghana again drives it to mid off.
On a good length, on off. Sabbhineni Meghana drives it uppishly to mid off this time.
Length ball, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana drives it well but straight to mid off.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Overpitched delivery, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana gets to the pitch of the ball and creams it through point for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Shafali Verma pushes it towards covers. She crosses ends.
Well bowled! Good-length ball, outside off, nipping away. Shafali Verma has a poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Who will start from the other end? It is Hannah Rowe.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Length ball, leg-lined. Sabbhineni Meghana tucks it off her pads to fine leg for another boundary. Good start for India Women. 10 runs from the first over.
On a length, on off. Shafali Verma dabs it to point for a single. She gets off the mark as well.
Pulls her length back a little bit, outside off. Shafali Verma defends it out to the off side.
On a length, on leg. Sabbhineni Meghana misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. The batters take a leg bye.
Length ball, on leg. Sabbhineni Meghana chips it to mid on.
FOUR! Lovely start! A juicy half-volley dished out, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana prods and drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.

We are all set for the action. The players are out to the middle. No signs of Smriti Mandhana yet so it is another chance for Sabbhineni Meghana to showcase her talent along with Shafali Verma.  Lea Tahuhu to start with the ball. Here we go ...

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Sabbhineni Meghana, Yastika Bhatia, Mithali Raj (C), Harmanpreet Kaur, Taniya Bhatia (WK) (In for Richa Ghosh), Deepti Sharma, Jhulan Goswami (In for Simran Bahadur), Renuka Singh (In for Pooja Vastrakar), Sneh Rana (In for Rajeshwari Gayakwad), Ekta Bisht (In for Poonam Yadav).

New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Suzie Bates, Sophie Devine (C), Amelia Kerr, Amy Satterthwaite, Maddy Green, Lauren Down (In for Brooke Halliday), Katey Martin (WK), Frances Mackay (In for Jess Kerr), Lea Tahuhu (In for Hayley Jensen), Hannah Rowe (In for Fran Jonas), Rosemary Mair.
TOSS - New Zealand Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

New Zealand have outplayed India in both matches and would look to repeat the same performance whereas India will be under pressure to secure victory and stay alive in the series. The return of Smriti Mandhana, Renuka Singh and Meghna Singh will bolster their chances as well. The picturesque John Davies Oval in Queenstown continues to be the battleground. Toss and team news in a bit.

Hello everyone and a warm welcome to the third ODI of the five-match series between New Zealand Women and India Women. The hosts have won both games so far and would be keen here to seal the series with another thumping win. The visitors are still eyeing their first win of the tour and have to come up with a better performance in all three facets as it's practically a do-or-die game for them.
... Match Day...
